title: Unit – 1 : Session – 4 : SLO – 1  |  Kernel Structures — Reverse Word Search
sections: I. Words to Place in the Grid
EXOKERNEL — minimalist kernel that exposes hardware to applications, giving them more direct control.
HYBRID KERNEL — combines features of monolithic and microkernels; used in modern OS like Windows and macOS.
LAYERED — organized in levels; each one builds on services provided by the one below it.
MICROKERNEL — only includes essential functions like IPC and basic scheduling; everything else runs in user space.
MODULAR — allows components to be loaded and unloaded at runtime, often used in Linux systems.
MONOLITHIC — single large process running entirely in kernel mode with all OS services included.
SIMPLE — basic structure with minimal functionalities, often used in teaching or early systems.
VIRTUAL MACHINE — creates an abstraction of physical hardware; runs multiple OSes on the same physical system.
